Target: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD). AMD designs computing and graphics processors, including Ryzen, EPYC and Radeon products, serving PC, data-center, gaming and embedded markets.

Focal announcement: AMD Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results.

Decision cutoff: 2026-02-03T23:59:59-05:00. Only information available before this cutoff is admissible.

Source: AMD Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results. Published: 2026-02-03. URL: https://ir.amd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1276/amd-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results.

Condensed source facts; other details are omitted: SANTA CLARA, Calif., Feb. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- AMD (NASDAQ:AMD) today announced financial results for the fourth quarter and full year of 2025. Fourth quarter revenue was a record $10.3 billion, gross margin was 54%, operating income was $1.8 billion, net income was $1.5 billion and diluted earnings per share was $0.92. For the full year 2025, AMD reported record revenue of $34.6 billion, gross margin of 50%, operating income of $3.7 billion, net income of $4.3 billion, and diluted earnings per share of $2.65. “Our record fourth quarter and full-year results demonstrate AMD’s ability to deliver profitable growth at scale,” said Jean Hu, AMD executive vice president, CFO and treasurer. (1) Full year 2025 results included approximately $440 million in net inventory and related charges as a result of the U.S. Government's export control on AMD Instinct™ MI308 data center GPU products.

Qualitative interpretation of explicitly identified source percentages: One explicitly cited gross margin figure means roughly half of revenue remained after the cost of goods sold, before operating costs. Keep its stated period and accounting basis; this alone is not a new cash-flow estimate.

The exact historical text version is unverified. This is an incomplete source-based reconstruction.

Expectations: No point-in-time analyst consensus or market-implied expectation is available.

No company-wide comparable financial baselines or incremental magnitude inputs were supplied. Do not infer that a large headline amount is material to the target.

These are coarse descriptions computed from observed historical inputs. Strong past movement or relative strength is not evidence that the next return must continue or reverse.

The previously fitted market-only reference model favored an upward return beyond the neutral band. Its leading outcome was favored, with meaningful uncertainty. It still assigned meaningful possibility to a return inside the narrow neutral band and a downward return beyond the neutral band. This is a training-only model forecast, not an observed outcome or independent news evidence.

The neutral return band's half-width is much narrower than the code-computed ordinary five-session variability scale. An irrelevant article does not eliminate ordinary price movement; this is not a calculated class probability.

Forecast target: entry is the first regular-session open after the cutoff; exit is the fifth session close, counting entry as session one. Raw return above +1% is up; within inclusive -1% to +1% is flat; below -1% is down. The initial pre-entry reaction is outside this target.

Do not invent analyst consensus, incremental target sales, new corporate cash payments, or an already-priced news reaction.
